verdict.rationale: Evidence mentions cloud/background agents that 'use their own computers to build, test, and demo features' and can run 'for hours or days,' implying some cloud execution environment, but there is no documentation of how a developer configures that environment (e.g., dependency installation, setup scripts, environment config file) to make it reproducible. Missing for 10: any mention of an environment configuration mechanism (like an environment.json/Dockerfile), dependency installation steps, or reproducibility guarantees for cloud agent workspaces.
